description: A libre lightweight streaming front-end for Android.

latest_release.name: v0.29.2
latest_release.body:
This releases brings a bunch of player fixes and improvements for YouTube.

### New
- [YouTube] Add support for "Podcasts" and "Courses" tabs - #13713
- Add brotli support to downloader - #13789
- Feature: Divide player seekbar by chapters - #13430

### Improved
- Improve look of search menu "titles" - #13605 
- [YouTube] Update Piped and Invidious instances - #13767
- Enabled asynchronous ARM Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) - #13862
- Show full subtitle names when the service exposes them - #13874
- a11y: contentDescription for play button and sort icon - #13851
- Show queue progress and total duration for popup and background queue #13942 #13972

#### Translation updates
 - strings #13707 #13737 #13748 #13791 #13832 #13885
 - compose #13708 #13736 #13750 #13788 #13839 #13889

### Fixed
- Fix audio ducking issue by using ExoPlayer's automatic audio focus management - #13169
- Fix: blacklist JMGO N1S 4K and TCL 65Q651G for media tunneling - #13756
- Fix: black video delay when entering fullscreen - #13764
- Fix opening links with timestamps - #13781
- Fix playlist not clearing when navigating back - #13732
- Use app locale instead of content locale for local list dates - #13843
- Hide current fragment when opening settings search - #13857
- Keep the chosen audio track when resuming downloads - #13883
- Feed: prevent group name subtitle leak into other fragments - #13974 
- [Bandcamp] Fix NetworkOnMainThreadException on rotate / back - #13955

### Development
- Replace KeyboardUtil with library helper class - #13711
- Mention word mark in README - #13685
- Handle Description conversion to record class - #13553
- Update PR template to encourage users to explain their testing/QA procedure - #13720
- Make using the PR template mandatory in the contribution guidelines - #13804
- [YouTube] Update NewPipeExtractor and adapt to removals - #13801
- Migrate settings appearance screen - #13684
- fix: log stream progress save errors with Log.e - #13849#13849
- Add missing function parameter comment documentation - #13865
- Fix inconsistent History page title when opening the History page from the sidebar - #13457 
- Update user agent to Firefox ESR 153 - #13887

### Dependency updates
- Update Gradle and dependencies - #13787 #13901 #13935 #13988
- Migrate room to v3 - #13903
